The builder applies the following default configuration:

- Port: `1521` (see `OracleBuilder.OraclePort`)
- Environment variable: `APP_USER=oracle` (see `OracleBuilder.WithUsername(string)`)
- Environment variable: `ORACLE_PASSWORD=oracle` (see `OracleBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Environment variable: `APP_USER_PASSWORD=oracle` (see `OracleBuilder.WithPassword(string)`)
- Wait strategy: Waits until a message matching `DATABASE IS READY TO USE!` is logged.
